# A. Duie Pyle Opens New Warehouse Facility, Creating a Fully Integrated Logistics Center in Central Pennsylvania 

 October 5, 2026 • 488 words 

The Northeast’s leading supply chain provider will now offer warehousing and LTL transportation services out of its Camp Hill site, giving customers faster, more flexible distribution across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic and Ohio

WEST CHESTER, Pa. — October 5, 2026 — A. Duie Pyle (Pyle), a premier, 102-year-old family-owned and operated provider of asset and non-asset-based supply chain solutions, today announces the opening of a new warehouse facility in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania. Positioned directly adjacent to the company’s existing less-than-truckload (LTL) service center, the facility transforms the site into a fully integrated logistics center that brings warehousing and transportation operations together on one connected campus, providing customers with greater speed, flexibility and supply chain efficiency.

Averitt expands logistics network with Jackson, Mississippi, facility - FreightWaves

## Facility offers flexible warehousing, fulfillment options 

 Todd Maiden 

· Thursday, August 27, 2026 

 Less-than-truckload carrier Averitt announced the opening of a 100,000-square-foot distribution and fulfillment facility in Jackson, Mississippi. (Photo: Jim Allen/FreightWaves) 

Less-than-truckload carrier Averitt said Thursday it has opened a 100,000-square-foot distribution and fulfillment facility in Jackson, Mississippi. The announcement follows other recent investments the carrier has made to its network.

The new warehouse is near central Mississippi’s major freight lanes of I-20 and I-55. The Mississippi Department of Transportation announced Tuesday a $400 million project to improve the roadways and bridges along these corridors. The plan also calls for rail upgrades.

Most national LTL carriers have nearby service centers and Averitt operates a 57-door LTL terminal next to the new facility.

## About the Job

Join Dohrn Transfer as a Part-Time Outbound Dockworker

Dohrn Transfer is a leading Midwest LTL carrier, delivering less-than-truckload, truckload, and value-added services across a 10-state region. We're growing and looking for motivated individuals to join our team at the Oak Creek, WI terminal. This part-time role offers a great way to earn a competitive wage in a fast-paced, rewarding environment.

### What You'll Do

You will be responsible for conveying freight to and from trailers and storage areas. This can be done by hand or with the assistance of forklifts and hand trucks. Your day-to-day will involve loading and unloading freight according to DOT requirements, sorting and securing items on trucks or the dock to prevent damage. You'll handle a variety of materials, including cartons, bags, cylinders, boxes, crates, drums, pipe, bars, and rugs.
